# Contributing to Tablib

Thanks for your interest in contributing to Tablib! This document provides a
brief guide to get you started. For the full contributing guidelines
(including the Jazzband Code of Conduct), please see
[.github/CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Project layout

This project uses a `src/` layout. The package source code lives under
`src/tablib/`, while the test suite lives in the top-level `tests/`
directory. Keeping the package code separated from the repository root
(under `src/`) helps ensure that tests run against the installed package
rather than accidentally picking up files from the working directory.

## Running the test suite

Tablib's tests are written using [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). To run
them locally:

1. Install the package together with its test dependencies, e.g.:

   ```bash
   pip install -e ".[test]"
   ```

2. Run the test suite from the repository root:

   ```bash
   pytest
   ```

   You can also run a specific test file or test case:

   ```bash
   pytest tests/test_tablib.py
   pytest tests/test_tablib.py::SomeTestCase::test_something
   ```

Please make sure the test suite passes before submitting a pull request.
